about: The run after each dev release (#5197): Play from the launcher, the choice page, creation when the character is new, the world, the journal, the inventory and the game's menu, with a screenshot of each. tests/real-client/README.md says how a step is written.

steps.why: the choice page is up and ours
past the scroll the way a person goes: the sealed scroll, then Continue
the slots are drawn
Play on the slot the page has picked, until the page says it is joining
a character this server has not got is made first: the race menu opens in the hall. A character it has goes straight to the world, and the race menu steps are skipped
R, the race menu's Done
the question whether the face is done, when there is one
Enter takes the box's first answer
the question is answered
a second and a half for the name box, which is inside the race menu and says no menu of its own
Enter accepts the name the box holds
the face is done

a character still in the hall, new or made in an earlier run, takes Starting Location, Whiterun, Review, Confirm on the K panel as a person does; one the server has placed already skips the shot and the trip to town
steps.js: (function(){if(window.__ts5197home)return window.__ts5197home;var k=window.thornswoodSkills;if(!k||!k.isCreating)return '';var made=k.isCreating();if(made===null)return '';if(!made)return 'placed';var r=document.getElementById('ts-skills');if(!r||r.className==='gone')return '';var nav=[].slice.call(r.querySelectorAll('.nav .navrow'));function row(k){for(var i=0;i<nav.length;i++){var e=nav[i].querySelector('.k');if(e&&e.textContent===k)return nav[i];}return null;}var home=row('Starting Location'),review=row('Review');if(!home||!review)return '';var hv=home.querySelector('.v');if(hv&&/\bneed\b/.test(hv.className)){if(!/\bon\b/.test(home.className)){home.click();return '';}var cards=[].slice.call(r.querySelectorAll('.body .card'));var pick=null;for(var j=0;j<cards.length;j++){var n=cards[j].querySelector('.name');if(n&&/^Whiterun/.test(n.textContent)){pick=cards[j];break;}}if(!pick)pick=cards[0];if(pick)pick.click();return '';}if(!/\bon\b/.test(review.className)){review.click();return '';}var c=r.querySelector('[data-act="confirm"]');if(c&&!/\boff\b/.test(c.className)){c.click();window.__ts5197home='confirmed '+(hv?hv.textContent:'');return window.__ts5197home;}return '';})()

steps.why: off to the town
in the world, no loading screen
J, our journal
J again closes it
the game's own journal stays shut
I, the inventory
Tab, the game's menu
